correctness.rationale: C: Prior balance-generating polynomials F,G have exact Lie derivatives y²−Tx² and z²+(R−T)y²−Rx²y²; independent symbolic expansion confirmed. Invariance of xy yields ∫xz=−∫y². Cauchy–Schwarz and ∫y²=T∫x² imply ∫z²≥T∫y² for T>0. Substitute in second balance and divide by R>0. Equality forces z=−Tx µ-a.e.; invariant support is flow invariant, and L(z+Tx)|_{z=−Tx}=R(1−x²)y. The only orbit trapped in z+Tx=(1−x²)y=0 is origin, giving strictness for any other µ. Positivity of weighted (x²−1)y² forces mass at |x|>1,y≠0. Compact support legitimizes all polynomial averaged derivatives; no claim of existence for each T,R.
residual_risks: Compactly supported invariant µ, T,R>0 only; asserts neither recurrent-state existence nor positive quantitative excursion mass.
